class.name: ScenerySoundPlacement
class.brief_description: An ambient sound supplied by a [SceneryStreamingProvider].
class.description: An item of [constant SceneryStreamingProvider.CONTENT_SOUNDS]: a sound looped at its place by [code]ScenerySoundServer[/code] while its cell is supplied and the listener is within its reach. It is named by nothing, so no event plays or stops it.

members.member: Where the sound is in the world.
How far it is heard [m]; it is streamed that far.
What is looped - a stream that loops itself.
